packageRules.description: Auto-merge everything except major updates (those need review) — CI still has to pass first.

marked ships as a runtime dependency of the published package, so its updates reach every consumer — keep them manually reviewed. In-range updates touch only the lockfile, so the published range does not narrow.
Dev dependencies are `catalog:` references, which Renovate reports from pnpm-workspace.yaml as pnpm.catalog.default.

lockFileMaintenance has no release timestamp, so the default timestamp-required behaviour leaves renovate/stability-days pending forever. pnpm-workspace.yaml minimumReleaseAge enforces the cooldown when the lockfile is regenerated.
Actions run in release.yml with publishing rights; a pinned SHA only helps if someone reads the bump.
takumi 2.16 renamed FontSubset's ranges, which blume still reads (see the override in pnpm-workspace.yaml). Allow 2.16 once blume reads the new field.
